q1_issues.issue: The "for spreading racist ideology" argument of "vehicles" is reified and asserted at top level as an occurring spread event, but a noun's for-argument must be asserted nowhere — the instruction set states this with the same example ("a vehicle for spreading does not claim spreading occurred").
(Instrument sk_spread_1 language) asserts that language actually was the means of an actual spreading of racist ideology, a fact the sentence never states.

No (For <noun-symbol> <argument>) atom is emitted, so the one relation the instruction set licenses for this construction — the aboutness link between the vehicle and the spreading — is missing entirely.

q2_gaps: "one of the most ADJ1, ADJ2 and ADJ3 Ns" — membership in a superlative-ranked subset: Most covers only "X is the most ADJ N", the partitive forms quantify subjects rather than copular predicates, and nothing records "one of the most …", so the superlative and all three coordinated adjectives are dropped
notes: (Inheritance language vehicle) at 0.9/0.9 and the racist_ideology genus/modifier decomposition are right. The core defect is that the noun-complement clause is asserted as fact instead of being recorded with For.
